about.text: A semi-hard alp cheese from Nidwalden, about 6 to 8 kg, sold mild, spicy or sharp. In the general Alpkäse way, rennet is added at about 32 °C, the curd is heated to 45 to 54 °C, pressed, then brined for one to two days.

sources.text: Its weight, flavours and the general Alpkäse process, from the article.
